g.title: legacy_highlevel
g.text: 4 deployable EARs on one J2EE 1.3 app server · coupled ONLY through JMS (7 queues + 1 topic) · one shared Cloudscape DB, segregated by context
solid black = HTTP / SOAP / EJB call · dashed red = JMS · dotted green = JDBC / CMP persistence

g.title: cluster_jms
g.text: JMS backbone — the ONLY coupling between the 4 EARs (at-least-once delivery → MDBs must be idempotent)

g.title: cluster_db
g.text: Cloudscape DB — one physical schema, but each EAR's CMP maps to its OWN tables (22 total). Green = hand-written relational · Red = CMP-generated · ⚠ = value table DUPLICATED across EARs (no single owner)

g.title: pet
g.text: publish PO as XML → AsyncSenderQueue (NO order persist)

g.title: adm
g.text: list orders by status · submit approve / deny

g.title: sup
g.text: reserve from InventoryEJB, ship, invoice back

g.title: db_adm
g.text: A thin GUI over opc.ear's data.
